speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Early, and quieter than you usually bring me. Sit. I am not asking why.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I am still wet. The bolster could have been wrung out over the yard. I am not proud of the contribution.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A cup. I am going to drink it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am going to drink it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The not-drinking is getting the laugh. I am surprised. I am doing it smaller.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: You have not named a new practice. The room laughed at the pause. Leave the pause its own size.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody at this table has said they are afraid. I am noticing the fact, and I am not improving it.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Let it run. A cup is not a proclamation.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: The ordinary closes when the watch says, Master Kemp, and I'd as soon the watch had nothing to say.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then the jug can sit between me and them. I can work with a jug. I am not working with a speech.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The reckoning was fourteen. I am wetter than the news. I am not asking the cup to become a second cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourteen is behind us. The pause is the size of the laugh. That is what I am taking.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Take the size. Leave me the cup. I may yet drink it, and if I do, it will be a small drink.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Small is how you keep that table from becoming the watch's business. I have set the jug. I am done setting things.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Done is a blessing. My shirt is not done. I am going to pretend it is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have the timing. I am leaving with that, and with nothing larger than the timing.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Nothing larger. Good. A large moral would have ruined the cup, and the cup was the whole of my art this hour.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Then pay the ordinary its ordinary, and take the art into the heat. I have a house to keep this side of a complaint.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Fourteen was the share. This supper is not a debate about whether a supper is allowed. I am eating.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Eat. I am still on the smaller pause. The door table has turned back, which is the effect, and I did not know I was aiming at it.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Turned back is enough. I do not need them to clap a man for holding a cup.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No clap. The timing is the lesson. I am not taking a rule about the city home with it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You, not a rule. I can live with being a lesson if the lesson is short.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Short. My shirt agrees. It has no speeches left.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Then the ordinary is still open, because the watch has not spoken, and I would like to keep it that way.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We will not make the watch a guest. The cup stays half up. That is the end of it.
